entry.title: Randall Park Hosts the UCLA College Lecture Awards

media:group.media:title: Randall Park Hosts the UCLA College Lecture Awards
media:group.media:description: Join writer, actor, comedian, and director Randall Park ('97) as he hosts the inaugural UCLA College Lecture Awards. The inaugural College Lecture Awards, hosted by Randall Park, paid tribute to the best Bruin ideals of higher education and honored five College faculty members, each of whom shared insights into their research and scholarship: Eric Avila (division of undergraduate education), Martha Bailey (division of social sciences), Wesley Campbell (division of physical sciences), Helen Deutsch (division of humanities) and Elaine Hsiao (division of life sciences). AUDIO DESCRIPTIVE VERSION: https://youtu.be/9e4ClIj2E6g

entry.title: Going for Culinary Gold: UCLA Dining Prepares for the Olympics

media:group.media:title: Going for Culinary Gold: UCLA Dining Prepares for the Olympics
media:group.media:description:
Join Chef Joey Martin, Senior Executive Chef for UCLA Dining, as he breaks down what it takes to prepare for the global stage. Partnering with LA28 and Aramark, UCLA Dining is scaling up operations from serving 33,000 meals a day to over 60,000 daily meals to support up to 17,000 world-class athletes and officials. Discover how world-class culinary expertise and athlete-focused nutrition come together to create a supportive environment where champions can recharge, decompress, and perform at their best.
AUDIO DESCRIBED VERSION: https://youtu.be/cIZLiBfgs2c

entry.title: This Chemistry professor wants you to change the world

media:group.media:title: This Chemistry professor wants you to change the world
media:group.media:description:
In his lab that works on innovative ways to create materials, Osvaldo Gutierrez speaks about nurturing the next generation of scientists.
Gutierrez is a Professor of Chemistry and Biochemistry, the Fraser and Norma Stoddart Chair in Contemporary Chemistry, and UCLA Chicano Studies Research Center STEM Senior Faculty Director.

media:group.media:title: UCLA Latinx Welcome Celebration 2026
media:group.media:description: A new school year means new connections, new experiences, and a community to call home. The 2026 Latinx Welcome Celebration brings Bruins together at UCLA to celebrate culture, build connections, and welcome students into the Bruin family. From campus activities to shared moments with friends and fellow students, the celebration highlights the sense of community that makes UCLA special. entry.title: Dr. Knaul on Breast Cancer Awareness

media:group.media:title: Dr. Knaul on Breast Cancer Awareness
media:group.media:description:
October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month. Nearly 20 years ago, a medicine discovered here at UCLA saved Dr. Knaul's life. Now she works to make sure more women everywhere can get the screening and care they need.
Please share this with the women you love. Don't fear breast cancer. Fear not knowing you have breast cancer.
AUDIO DESCRIPTIVE VERSION: https://youtu.be/95yqH3ylJ7s

entry.title: Help for Harassment at UCLA: The Civil Rights Office

media:group.media:title: Help for Harassment at UCLA: The Civil Rights Office
media:group.media:description:
UCLA’s Civil Rights Office is here to respond to issues like discrimination, sexual misconduct and retaliation. Chancellor Julio Frenk explains how the CRO can provide Bruins across UCLA with support and resources, even if they do not want to make a formal complaint. Learn more, ask questions or connect with the Civil Rights Office: civilrights.ucla.edu civilrights@ucla.edu (310) 825-7012
For an audio described version of this video, please click here https://youtu.be/uzZadZd3jEA
